SHITET APARTAMENT 1+1 RRUGA E KOSOVAREVE
Ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te kryeqytetit si Rruga e Kosovareve ofrojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 1+1.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje pallati ekzistues.
Zona konsiderohet nga me atraktivet pasi ofron facilitete te ndryshme per nje jetese komode.
Orientimi qe ka ben qe apartamenti te mare drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites.
Me nje siperfaqe totale prej 62.30m2 organozohet ne:
korridor shperndares
sallon dhe ambjent gatimi
1 dhome gjumi
1 tualet
Te dhena te tjera:
description_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE In one of the most sought-after areas of the capital, such as Kosovare Street, we offer for sale a 1+1 apartment. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an existing building. The area is considered one of the most attractive as it offers various facilities for a comfortable life. Its orientation makes the apartment receive natural light throughout the day. With a total area of ​​62.30m2, it is organized into: distribution corridor, living room and kitchen area, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom. Other information:
